title.en: An Act to Provide a Minimum Salary of Forty Pesos a Month for Municipal-School Teachers in the Public Schools of the Philippine Islands.
title.orig: An Act to Provide a Minimum Salary of Forty Pesos a Month for Municipal-School Teachers in the Public Schools of the Philippine Islands.

text.en:
No permanently appointed municipal or provincial-school teacher shall receive a compensation
of less than forty pesos a month.
Division superintendents of schools are required to carry out the provisions of the preceding

This Act shall take effect in January, nineteen hundred and twenty-eight.
Approved, December 3, 1927.
